item.title: India's health wearables market gets competitive as brands double down on consumer needs
item.description: India's wearables market is entering a more competitive phase, with brands looking beyond step counts and specifications to build products around how consumers sleep, recover, exercise and manage their health. As players compete for daily engagement, the battleground is shifting from features to the value they create for consumers.

item.title: Tata, Mahindra and the Dutchman wearing India's colours: Independence eve at London's old dock
item.description: As Mahindra chases its best-ever finish and Jaguar TCS Racing leads the championship, a season built on a decade-old bet on India comes down to two races and one Dutchman's word that the group is "finding the edge."

item.title: Gen Z replaced the mall with screenshots. Peter England wants to meet them there
item.description: A saved Instagram post, a creator's outfit or a screenshot of a look can now be the starting point for a fashion purchase. As Gen Z reshapes how young consumers discover and shop for clothing, Peter England is looking to its new lifestyle collection VYBE to build a more contemporary proposition for the next generation.
